proposed_title: Price transmission dossier: official CPI movement is a lead, not proof of household relief
what_happened: A fresh Cloud GET retrieved HCP's current July 2026 CPI release and a separate GET retrieved the World Bank's exact Morocco climate-and-development report page. The current official data supports a possible research lead on uneven price transmission, while the older independent report supplies structural risk context only. Neither source supports misconduct or a publishable investigation.
key_facts: OFFICIAL_CLAIM: HCP reports overall CPI down 0.6% year-on-year, with food down 3.7% and non-food up 1.9% in July 2026.
ESTIMATE: the World Bank report frames water scarcity and climate exposure as structural development risks; its scenarios are not present price observations.
UNKNOWN: household microdata, wages, retail margins, regional supply conditions and causal links were not retrieved.
FACT: no accusation against a public or private actor is supported by this packet.

primary_sources.claim_supported: Current aggregate and category CPI changes
primary_sources.independence: Official statistical producer; requires household and market evidence for an investigation

independent_sources.attribution: World Bank Morocco Country Climate and Development Report page
independent_sources.claim_supported: Dated independent structural context on climate, water and development risk
independent_sources.independence: Multilateral analysis separate from HCP, but dated and not evidence of July 2026 price causation

contradictory_evidence: Food CPI fell while non-food CPI rose year-on-year, warning against a single household-relief narrative.
Structural water-risk scenarios do not establish causation for a monthly price movement and do not imply wrongdoing.
uncertainty: RESEARCHING / NEEDS_VERIFICATION: the current aggregate signal is real, but distribution, causation and accountability are unresolved.
context: A responsible dossier would compare CPI micro-components with household expenditure, wages, wholesale and retail series, and seek disconfirming explanations.
why_it_matters: Aggregate inflation can mask divergent pressures across products, places and household budgets.
strategic_angle: HOLD; request current microdata and independent market evidence. Make no accusation.
